thanks for the tests
It would be nice if we had #embed here (C++26) and we could just check in a dummy pldm package.

With how it's written now we at least have some testcases where the package content can be manually verified to be in spec.

If we get a larger amount of testcases in the future, yes, writing everything down like done here is probably not the way to go, but then we will be relying on whatever generated these packages to be correct.
considering that I think there's like one tool that does it for everyone (the one in the pldm github repo), afaik, not a huge risk but yeah you're right
nit, doesn't matter for this conversation, but I thought there was a constructor from std::vector<T> to std::span<T>?

nice catch, yes, we can save a few lines by using the implicit conversion.

Changed it here and in a few other places.
lgtm, thanks for the tests.
